# Map logical toolbar movement to physical arrow keys for the document direction

Current list-box selection treats ArrowRight as forward in an LTR document and backward in RTL. The tests derive KEY_ArrowRight/Left through getKey rather than hardcoding forward as Right. They inspect shadowRoot.activeElement for focus inside the pane and selectedItem for the logical list selection. The palette test also handles an optional scroll-container tab stop. Keep logical order, physical key and focus owner separate in neighboring tests. Browser/platform and screen-reader behavior were not executed.

Scope: mail/components/unifiedtoolbar.
